name: omnibase/marketplace
description: Marketplace for base-bundle: stores, products and variants, carts and orders, payment through pluggable gateways, sales rules (discounts, fees, taxes), reviews

suggest.glitchr/omnitrade: Pay through its gateways (omnitrade/stripe, omnitrade/paypal...): a PaymentMethod names one
suggest.glitchr/omnibus: Ship through its carriers (omnibus/mondial-relay, omnibus/ups...): a ShippingMethod names one
suggest.glitchr/omnibill: Send the invoices through its gateways, their lifecycle statuses kept (marketplace.invoice.gateway); not on Packagist yet - a vcs repository, https://github.com/glitchr-studio/omnibill
suggest.omnibill/email: The default invoicing gateway: the invoice e-mailed from the seller's address, its statuses kept by hand (https://github.com/glitchr-studio/omnibill-email)
suggest.omnibill/afnor: An approved platform (XP Z12-013), the day the shop must issue through one (https://github.com/glitchr-studio/omnibill-afnor)
suggest.glitchr/omnisign: Accept a priced quote by signing it in the page (marketplace.quotes.signature), with glitchr/omnibase's Base\Service\Signatures; not on Packagist yet - https://github.com/glitchr-studio/omnisign
